title: The Fire Engine with Many Pockets
synopsis: At the firehouse open day, Rex and Molly investigate the many equipment compartments of a pumper engine while Gus looks for a place to store an imaginary enormous biscuit.
continuity_state: Before: Captain Ann has introduced Station Lane and its two red trucks. It is now the open day, and Rex, Gus, Jack and Aunt Jo have arranged to meet Molly and Farmer Ruth. After: The visitors recognize that the shorter red vehicle is a pumper engine, carrying hose, an onboard water tank and pump, and stored tools. Molly and Rex visit the firehouse together for the first time. No tools are removed from service, and the apparatus is left ready.
